text: This is a nice simple alarm clock with the controls on the front .... This is a nice simple alarm clock with the controls on the front and big numbers.  We have had many clocks that were complicated and inconvenient to set, so I was looking for an easy to use clock this time.  It does what I want it to and it's a nice small size.
